answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the zenith of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A voyage of per-task receipts records who did what, and the island of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
